script.cover_1: Your idea, in your manager's voice. Can they do that?
script.payoff: It feels unfair, and a short written note afterwards often keeps the record.
script.caption: A short note after the meeting costs a minute and keeps your name on your work. Send this to the one whose idea was borrowed.
script.situation: Can your manager present your idea as their own?
script.answer: It feels unfair, and what happens next depends on the company. A short email afterwards often keeps the record.
script.reply_me: Quick note for the record: I built the vendor plan. Could I present it on Friday?
